about: The Workbench icons of the SevenKingdoms drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art is the game's own program icon (data/IMAGE/7K_ICON.BMP, black as its colour key, as the game uses it for its window). SevenKingdoms-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, SevenKingdoms.info beside the drawer; it has its own name here so as not to meet the program's SevenKingdoms.info. Data.info is the icon of every data subdrawer and of Saves (the Makefile copies it to each name).
